questions.question: Identify the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: 'If only I [think] differently about the problem, we might have avoided this conflict.'
options: think
had thought
should think
would think

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation?
options: If I were you, I would not make that mistake.
If I was you, I would not make that mistake.
If I had been you, I would not make that mistake.
If I will be you, I would not make that mistake.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would not make that mistake.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences demonstrates correct ellipsis?
options: She knows English, but he doesn't French.
She knows English, but he doesn't too.
She knows English, but he doesn't neither.
She knows English, but he doesn't as well.
questions.answer: She knows English, but he doesn't too.

questions.question: Select the correct sentence that uses a cleft sentence structure to emphasize the location.
options: It was in the garden that we first met.
It was the garden that we first met in.
We first met in the garden, that was it.
The garden was where we first met.
questions.answer: It was in the garden that we first met.

questions.question: Which of the following conditional sentences correctly uses the third conditional to refer to a past unreal condition?
options: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would pass the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would pass the exam.
questions.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
